Corporate Governance · August 1, 2025

Invitation to Attend the Extraordinary General Assembly Meeting

Makamin Saudi Holding for Oil & Gas Services (Closed Joint Stock Company)
Commercial Registration No: 1010251168
To the Esteemed Shareholders,

The Board of Directors of Makamin Saudi Holding for Oil & Gas Services is pleased to invite you to attend the Extraordinary General Assembly meeting, which will be held – God willing – at 12:00 PM on Saturday, August 23, 2025, at the company's meeting headquarters in Riyadh – Al-Sulaimaniah District – Canary Complex, to consider the attached agenda.

Agenda Item (1)

Approval of amending the Articles of Association and aligning them with the new Companies Law.

Agenda Item (2)

Approval of the comprehensive roadmap for the company's re-establishment – presented by the reform team.

Agenda Item (3)

Disclosure and date of knowledge – facts regarding the sale of headquarters and liquidation of branches.

Agenda Item (4)

Statutory accountability of previous boards – presentation of previous board violations and the violations committee decision.

Agenda Item (5)

Approval of the reform team incentive program – to fund legal and technical recovery operations.

Agenda Item (6)

Approval of appointing Dr. Ibrahim Al-Jallal as Chairman of the Audit Committee.

Agenda Item (7)

Option to allocate a percentage of willing shareholders' shares for the reform council – voluntary and optional.

Agenda Item (8)

The Board of Directors may add any new developments or items, cancel items, or modify the agenda of the Extraordinary General Assembly at least ten days before the meeting date.

Important Notice – Quorum: If the statutory quorum is not met for the first meeting, a second meeting will be held one hour after the scheduled time of the first meeting at the same location. The second meeting is valid if shareholders representing at least one-quarter of the capital are present.

For inquiries: media@makamin.com.sa
